core_image.text: 言葉を行き来させて、話し合う

etymology: tale(話)、tell と同じ仲間 → (相手と)話す・話し合う → (話して人を動かす)説得して〜させる(talk A into doing)/ やめさせる(talk A out of doing)

en_definitions.text: to speak with someone; to persuade someone to do or not to do something by talking.
a conversation or discussion; a speech given to a group of people.

cautions: talk は自動詞が中心: talk to / with A(Aと話す)、talk about A(Aについて話す)。×talk A(人)
talk A into doing=Aを説得して〜させる / talk A out of doing=Aを説得して〜をやめさせる
speak は「声に出して言う」(speak English)、tell は「内容を伝える」(tell A B)、say は「言葉そのもの」
名詞 talk=話し合い・講演(give a talk)

patterns.meaning: Aを説得して〜をやめさせる

examples.label: talk to
examples.en: Can I talk to you for a minute?

examples.label: talk about
examples.en: We talked about our plans for the summer.
examples.ja: 私たちは夏の計画について話した。

examples.label: talk A into doing
examples.en: She talked her father into buying a new car.
examples.ja: 彼女は父親を説き伏せて新車を買わせた。

examples.label: talk A out of doing
examples.en: My friends talked me out of quitting the club.
examples.ja: 友だちに説得されて部活をやめるのを思いとどまった。

examples.label: 講演(名詞)
examples.en: The scientist gave a talk on climate change.
examples.ja: その科学者は気候変動について講演した。

examples.label: 話し合い(名詞)
examples.en: The two countries held peace talks.
examples.ja: 両国は和平の話し合いを行った。

check_points: talk A into doing と talk A out of doing の違いを言えるか
talk / speak / tell / say の使い分けを言えるか

exam.note: talk A into / out of doing と、say / tell / speak / talk の使い分けが定番。
